This small plot is mine, and I do not like to spend cash on a thing I have not seen help much on plots like this. For a plot this small, a fertilizer bag is too much for me, and going to buy chemicals is hard, so I will use what I have at home and plant the seed I usually keep. I will work it with family hands, keep it clean with the hoe, and I will not bring in paid workers unless I am forced, which I do not expect this season.
